purpose: Stage 3 Z-dissection of the excitatory cell: which boundary carries the upstroke charge that makes the maximum rise rate two to three times the human's at the same peak voltage. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-06-h01-energetic-isolation-plan.md.
holdout: Sweep 53 is not on disk and not an input of any stage.
evaluation: One parameter set at sweep 50 with soma current, capacitive and axial probes; sweep 43 has no spike and is not rerun.

subsystems.dendritic load: capacitance_factor dend:2 and apic:2 (spine-scale membrane capacitance)

R.title: Reference charge budgets at sweep 50, source and candidate
R.prediction: Candidate 5 spikes, source 7; maximum rise 641 and 1019 V/s against the human 351. During the upstroke (threshold to peak) the capacitive charge equals the sodium charge minus the axial charge to the dendrites; the axial fraction of the sodium charge is the load share. Closure residual per cycle below 1e-3 pC.
R.rejection: If closure fails the probes are re-checked. If the axial fraction is already above 0.6 of the sodium charge, the load cannot be the lever and Stage X tests the sodium boundary alone.
R.unchanged: Allen 541563728 geometry and mechanisms, recorded command and bias, nseg x9, CVode 1e-10, stop 2100 ms, library kv3-closing-source.

X.title: Two-arm split of the upstroke: sodium boundary against dendritic load
X.prediction: Halving the somatic sodium density lowers the peak by more than 5 mV and the rise rate by less than a third; doubling dendritic capacitance halves the rise-rate contrast (toward 350 V/s) and moves the peak by less than 3 mV. If the load arm reverses the rise-rate row and the sodium arm does not, the load is the Steep boundary.
X.rejection: If neither arm moves the rise rate by more than the Stage 1 limit (5.7 V/s combined) times five, the upstroke is set by sodium kinetics, not by density or load; report and stop.
X.unchanged: As Stage R; one boundary changed per arm.

Y.title: Initiation-site split: axonal sodium tripled, with and without somatic sodium reduced
Y.prediction: Axonal sodium density tripled (y-axon-na3): initiation moves to the axon; the soma shows a shoulder (a local dV/dt maximum of 100 to 300 V/s between -55 and -45 mV before the main rise), threshold falls toward -55 mV, the main rise rate stays within 10 percent of 641 V/s, peak within 2 mV of 36. Axonal sodium tripled with somatic sodium at 0.65 (y-axon-na3-soma065): shoulder present, main rise 350 to 500 V/s, peak 28 to 36 mV, threshold near -55 mV, five spikes. If the second arm brings the rise within 5 times the 5.7 V/s limit of 351 with the peak inside 2.07 mV of 36, the explanation is sufficient. Rejection: no shoulder appears in either arm, or the rise rate does not fall below 550 V/s in the second arm: initiation on this stub cannot reproduce the human's two-stage upstroke and the axon geometry (structural) is returned to the user.
